title: Digital Music Artist here. I have some questions.

posts.author: MorteEternal
posts.body:
Hello there,
I am a digital music artist just entering the field and have just released my first album on various platforms. I won't include them here, so this doesn't get taken down as advertising. That's not what this post is about.
#1: How do you actually sell resources for RPG Maker MZ? I went to the products area but I don't see an option to sell your content.
#2: I noticed there is a request for free music on here. I may get involved in that later if you can help me grow my channel in return.
#3: Where on these forums can I post my album?
Apologies if some of these things were easy to find and I goofed lol.
I've had no help at all and multiple deleted posts from mods apparently. I'm a little frustrated when I am just trying to be part of the community here. Does this forum even deal with that part of things?

posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
hiddenone answered most of the questions, but I'll share some additional info.
MorteEternal said:
#1: How do you actually sell resources for RPG Maker MZ? I went to the products area but I don't see an option to sell your content.
Click to expand...
You may also consider setting up an itch and/or bandcamp page to sell your music directly.
Considering you said you just released and distributed your album, I am assuming you went through something like Distro kid. If you aren't careful when setting up your album sales, they usually by default apply content ID checks around the internet, so if your music were to ever be played in a youtube video, the video would be claimed by Distrokid (or whomever you went with) on your behalf, stripping that channel of revenue.
While I pretty much disagree with this practice, my point isn't that your music is being claimed on a youtube video, but instead it sort of takes the music out of the "royalty free" market as well. Truly royalty free music does not tie itself to the content ID system used by Google and many other websites.
MorteEternal said:
#2: I noticed there is a request for free music on here. I may get involved in that later if you can help me grow my channel in return.
Click to expand...
You can help yourself grow your channel. That's you're job. Offer your service or don't, don't tie it to our actions, because you're gonna wind up disappointed.
Many people are interested in free music. Music often winds up being one of the most expensive parts of game dev, which is why many developers end up just turning to royalty free stuff instead of custom stuff. If you want to offer your capabilities for free, it would be greatly appreciated by many members here.
Assuming you are doing it for free, you can post in the project recruitment board, which is here:
Project Recruitment
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
Otherwise, if you are interested in offering your abilities for commission work, you'll need to have at least 30 meaningful contributions on the forum, at which point you'll be able to access the classified section where you can offer your skills for sale.
MorteEternal said:
#3: Where on these forums can I post my album?
Click to expand...
You can post your own stuff in the Art, Literature, and Music board if you just want to share it and nothing else.
Art, Literature, and Music
Post and discuss about your artistic endeavors whether if it's for RPG Maker or not.
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
The rules state that it's 1 thread per artist, so make a mega thread for sharing ALL of your music releases, not just a thread strictly about that single album.
On the other hand, if you are wanting feedback, you can share it in
@Ms Littlefish
's wonderful Audio Clinic thread.
The Audio Resource & Sound Design Clinic
It’s my goal that developers here talk about audio resources and sound design with the same ferocity they do the visual design and gameplay design. No element of the game’s design should be squandered away to the realm of “gets the job done.”  I envision this thread will serve two major...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
I also think there is a much older 'share your music' thread floating around. So you can just browse the forums until you find it.
Good luck!
